component.name: azure-iothub
component.title: Azure IoT Hub
component.description: Send device telemetry and device-twin updates to Azure IoT Hub.
component.label: cloud,iot,messaging

contentType.label: producer
contentType.description: Content type applied to telemetry messages.

deliveryMode.label: producer
deliveryMode.description: How the message body is delivered: telemetry, device twin reported properties, or both.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

protocol.label: producer
protocol.description: The protocol used to connect to Azure IoT Hub.

sendTimeoutMillis.label: producer
sendTimeoutMillis.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a device-to-cloud telemetry send.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

deviceClientEvictionInterval.label: advanced
deviceClientEvictionInterval.description: How often the pool is scanned for idle device clients to evict.

deviceClientIdleTimeout.label: advanced
deviceClientIdleTimeout.description: Idle time after which a pooled device client is evicted and closed.

connectionString.label: security
connectionString.description: The IoT Hub device connection string. Can be overridden per message via the CamelAzureIoTHubConnectionString header.

CamelAzureIoTHubDeviceId.label: producer
CamelAzureIoTHubDeviceId.description: The target device id. Overrides the device id configured on the endpoint.

CamelAzureIoTHubConnectionString.label: producer
CamelAzureIoTHubConnectionString.description: The per-device IoT Hub connection string. Overrides the connection string configured on the endpoint.

CamelAzureIoTHubDeliveryMode.label: producer
CamelAzureIoTHubDeliveryMode.description: Overrides the configured delivery mode for this message.

CamelAzureIoTHubTwinProperties.label: producer
CamelAzureIoTHubTwinProperties.description: Device twin reported properties to apply, as a Map. Used for TWIN delivery and, in BOTH mode, alongside the telemetry message body.

deviceId.label: producer
deviceId.description: Default device id used when the message does not carry a device id header.
